item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-11-18
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 今天论坛最热闹的是 Spark Program 的集中评审：委员会对 MoniMkt、TITANHOLD CKB Pay、secnev、CellGuard × CrowdCell 等项目给出了拒绝或不批准意见 [S02,S09,S15,S19]。Fiber RGB++ Swap 的关停通知出现预算金额和验收范围表述错误，委员会公开纠正并道歉，申请人也作出回应 [S07,S08]。社区项目方面，Cellula on Fiber 的投票结果公布为高票通过，Twine 继续收集反馈并修改提案，Turnmark 则在测试网推进预测市场 [S17,S04,S11]。 ## 重点话题 Spark 评审集中出结果：MoniMkt 被委员会表示暂不接受 [S02]；TITANHOLD CKB Pay 被遗憾告知未通过 [S09]；secnev 被拒绝 [S15]；CellGuard × CrowdCell 也未获批准 [S19]。 Fiber RGB++ Swap 出现通知纠错：委员会承认调整后的获批预算是等值 500 美元 CKB，而非通知中写的 1,000 美元，并为表述疏漏道歉 [S07]；委员会同时认为排除 RGB++ 集成后，仅有报价广播和发现功能不足以完成项目 [S07]；申请人 Carl 回应称 9 月交付是按他理解达成的工作，并非缩减替代 [S08]。 Cellula on Fiber 投票结果公布：Metaforo 记录 113,857,181 CKB 赞成、16 名投票者、零反对，超过 51% 门槛和最低参与要求...

item.title: [DIS] Twine — Non-Custodial P2P for Nervos CKB on Nostr and Fiber (3 posts)
item.description: 2. Summary CKB is still hard to buy or sell for local money. An exchange asks the seller to deposit the coins first. An identity check turns people away. Twine is the other path, and it already trades on testnet. Two people trade directly. The seller locks CKB in their own Fiber channel by paying a hold Twine creates. The buyer pays the seller in local currency, outside Twine. Twine keeps the order book. It can release that hold only by paying the buyer, and it learns the buyer’s secret only from that payment. Twine never holds the cash, and the operator cannot settle that lock into the operator’s own wallet. The operator does decide the dispute. The same person runs the hub and publishes...

item.title: Spark Program | Fiber RGB++ Swap (2 posts)
item.description: Hi @Carl ， 重新核对帖子后，我需要先纠正此前关停通知中的错误：本项目调整后的获批预算是等值 500 美元的 CKB，通知仍写成 1,000 美元，并沿用了原方案中包含 RGB++ 集成的部分表述。这是我在整理和发布通知时的疏漏，对此向你道歉。 关于验收范围，委员会当时对 #18 调整意见的理解是：排除 RGB++ 协议集成，保留包括基本 Swap 执行能力在内的核心开发。因此，委员会认为仅有报价广播和发现功能，还不足以完成本次项目。 但我也看到，你在 #20 的四周计划中只列出了报价发现相关工作，委员会没有及时指出这份计划与上述理解之间的差异。双方对范围的理解确实没有充分对齐。 你在第四周提交了完成全部范围的结项更新，委员会据此审核当时的交付物，并作出终止资助的决定。当时尚未实现 Swap，这一点你在后续回复中也已确认。不过，关于当时交付版本、测试情况的争议，仍应依据当时提交的材料核对。 对于十月补交的内容，感谢你的继续投入。但后来新增的功能不能作为九月已经完成交付的证明，也不会自动重启已经终止的资助，更不意味着预算恢复为原来的 1,000 美元。因此，不可能以此次补交为由，按原来的 1,000 美元方案结算。对原关停通知的纠正，与是否重新批准资助，是需要分别处理的事情。这只是我的个人工作失误，并非委员会更改了原本的决定。 Hi @xingtianchunyan, CKB Committee Thank you for taking your time to review this. item.title: Turnmark: short-round Up/Down prediction markets on CKB, live on testnet (1 posts)
item.description: Turnmark lets you take a position on a simple question: will an asset’s price finish higher or lower over a fixed round? We have BTC/USDT rounds running on Nervos testnet at two durations: 5 minutes and 15 minutes. You deposit test CKB into UP or DOWN before participation closes. The round compares committee-signed prices at its exact start and end boundaries. Winning shares can then be redeemed from the pool. There is no order book and no house quoting odds. Participants on the two sides fund a shared pot. Your potential payout depends on how much is deposited on each side. This is a working testnet application, not a mainnet launch. We are sharing it for people to try, review and help...

item.title: A second post-quantum lock for CKB? ML-DSA beside SPHINCS+, checked and measured (5 posts)
item.description: SHRINCS: 324-byte stateful post-quantum signatures Applications & Ecosystem A previous quantum resistant lock script was implemented using SPHINCS+, but its signature is quite large (from 8K to 50K). On a blockchain, storage is precious, and large signatures also impact TPS. Here we use SHRINCS, developed by BlockStream, which can achieve a signature of only 324 bytes in the minimal scenario. There are two methods of verifying SHRINCS: stateful and stateless. With stateful verification, the signature can be as small as 324 bytes, but the state (a count) must be stored … They are different as far as I can see: separate code, different verifier and message. Thanks for mentioning yours here....

item.title: [NOTICE] Fiber node runners: Please upgrade to v0.10.1 (1 posts)
item.description: Hi friends! If you’re still running version 0.9.x, please UPDATE to v0.10.1 soon. The 0.10 version updates how nodes communicate, so 0.9.x and 0.10.x nodes can NOT open new channels with each other. If you’re planning to open a new channel, check that your peer has upgraded too. Existing channels between two 0.9.x nodes can still be used for now. Please plan to close and settle these V1 channels soon, as they will no longer be supported in the next major release. Check the release notes for the full picture: v0.10.0: Releases · nervosnetwork/fiber · GitHub v0.10.1: Release v0.10.1 · nervosnetwork/fiber · GitHub
